nodes.name: Model Selection Recommendations
nodes.description: Decision atoms that consume diagnostic statistics and emit structured model selection recommendations

nodes.name: recommend_regularization
nodes.description: Recommend a regularization strategy (OLS/Ridge/Lasso/ElasticNet) based on condition number, n/p ratio, mutual incoherence, and Lasso viability.
nodes.type_signature: (condition_number: float, n_p_ratio: float, mutual_incoherence: float, lasso_viable: bool) -> dict

nodes.name: recommend_loss_function
nodes.description: Recommend a loss function (squared_error/huber/absolute_error) based on excess kurtosis of target and residuals.

nodes.name: recommend_linear_model
nodes.description: Recommend a linear model class and solver based on sample/feature counts, sparsity, dispersion index, and Tweedie power.
nodes.type_signature: (n: int, p: int, is_sparse: bool, dispersion_index: float, tweedie_power: float) -> dict

nodes.name: recommend_tree_ensemble
nodes.description: Recommend a tree ensemble type (HistGB/RandomForest/GradientBoosting) based on sample size, categoricals, and noise level.
nodes.type_signature: (n: int, n_categorical: int, noise_level: float) -> dict

nodes.name: recommend_preprocessing
nodes.description: Recommend preprocessing transformations based on skewness, VIF, sparsity, and scaling requirements.
nodes.type_signature: (skewness_array: NDArray[np.float64], vif_array: NDArray[np.float64], is_sparse: bool, model_requires_scaling: bool) -> dict

nodes.name: recommend_dimensionality_reduction
nodes.description: Recommend dimensionality reduction (PCA/TruncatedSVD/none) based on condition number, sparsity, and explained variance.
nodes.type_signature: (condition_number: float, is_sparse: bool, explained_variance: float) -> dict

nodes.name: recommend_hyperparameter_ranges
nodes.description: Recommend hyperparameter search ranges for a given model type based on sample and feature counts.
nodes.type_signature: (model_type: str, n: int, p: int) -> dict

nodes.name: recommend_cv_strategy
nodes.description: Recommend a cross-validation splitting strategy based on sample size, task type, temporal ordering, and grouping.
nodes.type_signature: (n: int, is_classification: bool, is_timeseries: bool, has_groups: bool) -> dict
